title: 2019 Novel Coronavirus-Infected Pneumonia on CT: A Feasibility Study of Few-Shot Learning for Computerized Diagnosis of Emergency Diseases.
summary: Few-shot, weakly supervised NCIP-Net diagnosed pneumonia on CT; AUC was 0.919 in test and 0.908 in external validation, above the tested Mask-R-CNN/SVM comparator.
